text: I was in Hadera for 5 years, got my citzenship 2 months ago. Usually is very hard to the security to let you in without an appointment. But sometimes we manage that they would give us a paper that we could write what we needed and the proper indetification and number of contact and they would contact or send a day and time for an appointment. Just as personal experience. But I cannot assure you that you will get anything. But my husband is an Israeli born here so he knows the ways to talk with other Israelis and we were well known in Hadera, the  clerks liked us. But again personal experience, cannot say for all
